name: article2broll-collage
title_zh: 文章拆成静帧再拼成B-roll的流水线
tagline_zh: 你只丢一篇文章，它先让编辑子代理出静帧提示词，再让媒体子代理生成B-roll素材。两段隔离跑，共享同一项目目录。
tagline_en: Drop an article; one subagent writes still prompts, another renders B-roll. Isolated runs, shared project folder.
desc_en: Orchestrate the complete article-to-editorial-stills-to-Grok-B-roll workflow by running the upgraded editorial and media skills sequentially in separate isolated subagents against one shared project. Use for article2broll collage, article-to-B-roll collage, or a complete article-to-video package; use the stage skills directly when only prompts or only media are requested.
why_zh: 把编辑和媒体拆成两个隔离子代理，各自升级各自跑，互不污染上下文。同一项目目录做粘合剂，编排层只管顺序。
why_en: Editorial and media run as separate isolated subagents, each upgraded and focused, sharing only the project folder.
limit_zh: 只吃完整文章到B-roll的整包流程；只要提示词或只要媒体时得直接用单段skill。不含最终视频合成。
limit_en: Only full article-to-B-roll packages; for prompts-only or media-only, call stage skills directly. Output stops at B-roll assets, no final edit. Each.
title_en: Article to stills to B-roll, two subagents one pipeline
